verdict.rationale: Flagsmith has its own headless surfaces. An official CLI manages flags, segments, projects and environments from the terminal and evaluates flags like an SDK. The Admin API claims full dashboard parity for programmatic management. A Docker setup can spin up a complete Flagsmith environment, which suits scripted or CI use. Missing for 10: explicit CI-pipeline documentation (e.g. CI actions or non-interactive token auth guidance), a published OpenAPI spec (probe 404), independent hands-on corroboration of CI usage.
